description: This file contains test cases for the audit-seams module using Vitest, testing various seam detection functions related to cron jobs, subagents, and parent streams. It also verifies coverage status reporting and help text content.

methods.name: runCronIsolatedAgentTurn
methods.description: Simulates running a cron agent turn, registering context, delivering payloads, and building session context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts cron service orchestration, recomputing upcoming runs, ensuring load, persisting state, arming timer, and running missed jobs.

methods.name: spawnSubagentDirect
methods.description: Handles spawning a subagent, registering its lifecycle, and emitting spawn event.

methods.name: completeRun
methods.description: Completes a subagent run, resolving context, capturing reply, emitting end hook, persisting subagent state, and initiating announce flow.

methods.name: startAcpSpawnParentStreamRelay
methods.description: Sets up parent stream relay for ACP spawn, listening to agent events, requesting heartbeat, and enqueuing system events.
